purpose: Present yourself as receiving someone’s helpful action.
keywords: Recipient + は / が + helper + に + て-form + もらう.
I had my friend carry my bags for me.
I had the teacher correct my essay.
I had my older sister take a photo for me.
formation: Recipient + は / が + helper + に + て-form + もらう.
restrictions: The recipient is the subject; くれる instead makes the helper the subject.
mistake: に marks the helper in the ordinary pattern.
